import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int n, k, mod;
    static int[] jc = new int[262155];
    static int[] inv = new int[262155];
    static int[] Log = new int[262155];
    static int[] jc2 = new int[262155];
    static int[][] dp = new int[262155][31];
    static boolean[][] vis = new boolean[262155][31];
    static List<Pair> tp = new ArrayList<>();
    static Queue<Pair> que = new LinkedList<>();

    static class Pair {
        int first, second;
        Pair(int f, int s) {
            this.first = f;
            this.second = s;
        }
    }

    static int getcnt(int x) {
        int cnt = 0;
        while (x != 0 && x % 2 == 0) {
            cnt++;
            x /= 2;
        }
        return cnt;
    }

    static int ksm(int x, long y) {
        long ret = 1;
        long base = x;
        while (y > 0) {
            if ((y & 1) == 1) {
                ret = (ret * base) % mod;
            }
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            y >>= 1;
        }
        return (int) ret;
    }

    static int C(int n, int m) {
        return (int)(((long)jc[n] * inv[m] % mod) * inv[n - m] % mod);
    }

    static int dfs(int n, int k) {
        if (n == 0) return 1;
        if (k == 0) return 0;
        if (dp[n][k] != -1) return dp[n][k];
        int di = 1 << Log[n];
        int ret = 0;
        for (int i = n; i >= di; i -= 2) {
            long temp = ((long) C(n, i) * dfs(n - i, k - 1)) % mod;
            ret = (int)((ret + temp * k) % mod);
        }
        dp[n][k] = ret;
        return ret;
    }

    static int bfs(int n, int k) {
        que.clear();
        tp.clear();
        que.add(new Pair(n, k));
        while (!que.isEmpty()) {
            Pair p = que.poll();
            int N = p.first;
            int K = p.second;
            tp.add(new Pair(N, K));
            if (N == 0 || K == 0) continue;
            int di = 1 << Log[N];
            for (int i = N; i >= di; i -= 2) {
                if (jc2[i] + jc2[N - i] == jc2[N] && !vis[N - i][K - 1]) {
                    vis[N - i][K - 1] = true;
                    que.add(new Pair(N - i, K - 1));
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = tp.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            Pair p = tp.get(i);
            int N = p.first;
            int K = p.second;
            if (N == 0) {
                dp[N][K] = 1;
                continue;
            }
            if (K == 0) {
                dp[N][K] = 0;
                continue;
            }
            int di = 1 << Log[N];
            for (int i = N; i >= di; i -= 2) {
                if (jc2[i] + jc2[N - i] == jc2[N]) {
                    long temp = ((long) C(N, i) * dp[N - i][K - 1]) % mod;
                    dp[N][K] = (int)((dp[N][K] + temp * K) % mod);
                }
            }
        }
        return dp[tp.get(0).first][tp.get(0).second];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        mod = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());

        for (int i = 0; i < 262155; i++) {
            jc[i] = (i == 0) ? 1 : (int)((long)jc[i - 1] * i % mod);
            Log[i] = (i == 0) ? -1 : (Log[i >> 1] + 1);
            jc2[i] = (i == 0) ? 0 : (jc2[i - 1] + getcnt(i));
        }

        inv[262154] = ksm(jc[262154], mod - 2);
        for (int i = 262153; i >= 0; i--) {
            inv[i] = (int)((long)inv[i + 1] * (i + 1) % mod);
        }
        inv[0] = inv[1];

        for (int i = 0; i <= 262154; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 31; j++) {
                dp[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }

        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(ksm(k, n));
        } else {
            int cnt = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 62; i++) {
                if (((long)n & (1L << i)) != 0) cnt++;
            }
            int ans = ksm(k, n);
            int res = (ans - bfs(n, k)) % mod;
            if (res < 0) res += mod;
            System.out.println(res);
        }
    }
}
